scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:backend && npm run dev -w @cs-inv-edit/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -ws --if-present && npm run build:backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.build:wasm-backend: mkdir -p apps/web/public/wasm && wasm_exec="$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" && if [ ! -f "$wasm_exec" ]; then wasm_exec="$(go env GOROOT)/misc/wasm/wasm_exec.js"; fi && rm -f apps/web/public/wasm/wasm_exec.js && cp "$wasm_exec" apps/web/public/wasm/wasm_exec.js && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -o apps/web/public/wasm/cs2-backend.wasm ./backend/cmd/wasm-backend
scripts.build:wasm-web: npm run build:wasm-backend && npm run build -w @cs-inv-edit/web
